daz.translation: abbr. Darwaz, Afghanistan 阿富汗，达尔华斯机场（代码）

daze.definition:
n. the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
n. confusion characterized by lack of clarity
daze.translation:
vt. 使茫然, 使发昏, 使眼花缭乱
n. 迷乱, 眼花缭乱

dazed.definition:
s. in a state of mental numbness especially as resulting from shock
s. stunned or confused and slow to react (as from blows or drunkenness or exhaustion)
dazed.translation:
a. 头昏的, 眼花的
[医] 茫然的, 迷乱的

dazedly.definition: r. in a daze; in a dazed manner
dazedly.translation: adv. 头昏眼花地, 眼花缭乱地, 茫然地

dazes.definition:
n the feeling of distress and disbelief that you have when something bad happens accidentally
n confusion characterized by lack of clarity
v to cause someone to lose clear vision, especially from intense light
v overcome as with astonishment or disbelief
dazes.translation: v. 晕眩的, 茫然的( dazed的现在分词 )

dazing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Daze
dazing.translation: v. 晕眩的, 茫然的( dazed的过去分词 )

dazzle.definition:
n. brightness enough to blind partially and temporarily
v. to cause someone to lose clear vision, especially from intense light
v. amaze or bewilder, as with brilliant wit or intellect or skill
dazzle.translation:
v. (使)眼花, 炫耀
n. 耀眼

dazzled.definition:
s. having vision overcome temporarily by or as if by intense light
s. stupefied or dizzied by something overpowering
dazzled.translation: a. 目眩的；眼花撩乱的

dazzlement.definition: n. Dazzling flash, glare, or burst of light.

dazzlers.translation: (dazzler 的复数) n. 引人注目的人

dazzles.definition:
n brightness enough to blind partially and temporarily
v to cause someone to lose clear vision, especially from intense light
v amaze or bewilder, as with brilliant wit or intellect or skill
dazzles.translation:
n. 耀眼, 令人赞叹的东西( dazzle的名词复数 )
v. 使目眩( dazzle的第三人称单数 ); 使惊异不已; 炫耀, 迷惑

dazzling.definition: s. amazingly impressive; suggestive of the flashing of lightning
dazzling.translation: a. 眼花缭乱的, 耀眼的

dazzlingly.definition: r. in a manner or to a degree that dazzles the beholder

dazzly.translation: 受强光而目眩,闪耀,使迷惑,闪光
